title: Quick-command buttons in the simple view and the full dashboard
goal: Both layouts show the configured quick commands as buttons; a tap renders the returned surface card with the bricks surface renderer, or opens the MCP Apps page or link
acceptance: One quick-commands component, used by the simple view (F-130-T16) and the full dashboard, reads the list from F-131-T01
A surface result renders with the web/src surface renderer (bricks surface components) in NERV's theme tokens; an MCP Apps page or link opens as such; an unavailable command says so
A test across the API and the component with a fake MCP result; checked at desktop and phone width, light and dark
privacy: Neutral invented commands, servers and results only; no tokens in configuration examples, tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one component over the existing surface renderer in both layouts, with a join test. Not a measurement.
